title: FBI Investigating Nvidia CEO's Alleged Affair
excerpt: US President Donald Trump stated that the FBI is investigating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over an alleged affair with a supposed Chinese spy.
body_html:
US President Donald Trump stated that the FBI is investigating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang regarding an alleged affair with a supposed Chinese spy.

According to the president, he spoke with Huang on Monday and questioned him directly about the relationship with the alleged spy.

Further details regarding the investigation or the nature of the allegations have not been officially detailed by law enforcement at this time.
